title: MJ-12 document: Cardinal Spellman given access to Roswell materials

tellings.quote: And there's one document around uh Francis Spellman being given access to the Roswell materials.

plain: One of the MJ-12 papers, a set of documents describing a secret committee said to have handled recovered UFO material, is said to record that Cardinal Francis Spellman, a senior American Catholic churchman, was given access to the materials from Roswell, the 1947 crash in New Mexico that some say was a flying saucer. Michels mentions this document in passing himself. If true, it would mean that the Church was let in on the secret from the start.
